title: Badan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yuchasin cites from the Arukh that it is a sage’s name, but Hyman says he has not found it there. He suggests the error arose because the Arukh, entry Badan, cites from the end of Orlah, “and the pomegranates of Badan,” explaining that it is a place-name. On Hyman’s account, Yuchasin encountered a faulty text in which it was written “a person’s name” or “a sage’s name.”
